reason: A mobile-focused PWA plugin that provides installable, offline-capable access to a local DeepSeek Harness Web UI through a separate approval and reverse-proxy gateway; human review is appropriate because it exposes a configurable network service and handles remote access.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可安装、支持离线和触控手势的移动端 PWA，并通过独立网关远程访问本地 Web UI。
summaries.en: Provides an installable, offline-capable mobile PWA for DeepSeek Harness with touch gestures and remote access to the local Web UI through a separate gateway.

capabilities: Runs an independent Node gateway subprocess
Listens on a configurable network address and port
Reverse-proxies requests to a local DSH Web UI
Injects PWA assets and mobile interaction behavior into served HTML
Caches static assets for offline use
Sends optional Web Push task-completion notifications
Applies device approval, token cookies, and per-IP rate limiting
